chapter_summary: She works against the short life of fresh plaster, watching each gesture become irreversible. A small mistake forces her to begin again.

spatality.place: a lime pit and a just-plastered panel inside a haveli
spatality.season: dry season, work done before the heat
spatality.route: pit to wall, a bucket carried the length of one corridor
spatality.texture: gritty lime under the nails, cool damp plaster, a smell that coats the throat

poetic_parameters.movement: New Formalism — return to traditional constraint, here the constraint of a surface that sets.
writing_skills: procedural sequence in strict working order
the body's labour as the poem's meter
poetic_parameters.image_seed: a thumbprint pressed into plaster that has begun to stiffen
poetic_parameters.volta: from the confidence of the first stroke to the discovery that the wall has already decided
poetic_parameters.sonic_texture: hard t and k in wet, set, crack, cut — the sound of a surface refusing
poetic_parameters.line_gesture: even, workmanlike lines; the sentence breaks exactly where the work breaks
poetic_parameters.variety_note: This is the first poem written from inside the making rather than from the admiring side, and the first to let a mistake stay visible.
poetic_parameters.metaphor_family: setting, curing, and the narrow window between soft and fixed
poetic_parameters.address: the panel, as a collaborator that will not negotiate
poetic_parameters.closing_move: a single instruction to the self, left unfinished
